integrity: Analytic argument is contained in RESULT.md; finite seeded checks and their results are separately recorded. Earlier scalar Bregman mode scores are attributed to prior literature.
scientific_limitations: Exact 3-eigenvalue, n>=3, rank-one, positive-definite and exact-arithmetic setting. Divergence tie choices excluded from competitive-ratio suprema. Not a claim about observed PCG runtime or higher rank. Later related Kaporin paper assessed from abstract only. No independent validation.
title: Logarithmic-mean phase diagram and sharp condition-number gap for rank-one Bregman preconditioning
